newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK DRAINS SKK900MLN IN REV REPO TENDERS.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK DRAINS SKK900MLN IN REV REPO TENDERS.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said it had drained funds totalling 900 million crowns through two securities reverse repurchase tenders on Tuesday.
In the NBS's one-day reverse repo tender, the average rate rose to 17.03 percent, after 16.32 percent in the previous reverse repo tender of a similar maturity on Monday.
In the central bank's three-day reverse repo tender, the average rate firmed to 17.00 percent from 16.42 percent in the previous three-day reverse repo tender, also on Monday.

The NBS added the one-day tender was oversubscribed, with 700 million crowns worth of bids from a total of 1.1 billion being accepted. All bids for the three-day tender totalling 200 million crowns were accepted.
The NBS holds tenders on a daily basis, if needed, instead of quoting securities repo and reverse repo rates.
